inferenceMethod: For each mock request, cache_hit events after composition + successful HTTP client spans count valid proposals. Exactly 3 => complete; 1/2 => partial. Source validity and no-empty contract covered by existing tests. The unmodified loadgen does not record response bodies.
testEvidenceReuse: No Go source or dependency changes since the validated commit; no need to rerun or overwrite evidence.
limits: One short run per version, same host/tools/default load and partner profiles, separate dates; no controlled measurement of other host resource consumers.
Synthetic workload repeats five risks; warm-cache throughput is not sustained capacity or production hit rate.
31 Redis GET operation failures are visible; healthy-read hit rate excludes them and is not the global avoided-HTTP fraction.
RNF results are scenario observations, not a production SLA; one valid proposal being useful remains a product assumption.
